description: Connects a dietary supplement blend to an organism represented by one of its non-botanical ingredient components, including probiotic organisms.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing the relationship; includes NHANES.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Date and time the relationship was created or last updated.

common_properties.name: category
common_properties.description: NHANES ingredient category: "Vitamin", "Mineral", "Other", or "Amino acid". If contributing components have differing categories, the value is "Other".

source_contributions.scope: Non-botanical components in the NHANES Dietary Supplement Ingredient File (DSBI), restricted to category codes 1 (Vitamin), 2 (Mineral), 4 (Other), and 5 (Amino acid), that map to an existing Organism node. Botanical components are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Organism assignments come from human-reviewed mappings of ingredient names. Components without a resolved organism are absent. Each relationship represents a unique blend–organism pair.
